decision: REJECT promotion; preserve incumbent. No rescue variant or GPU run.
interpretation: Every candidate case/load speedup is below both parents; all eight small-T normalized latencies rise.
26 compressed renamed SK2 launches in small-T profiles exercise the changed CL1 branch; six renamed uncompressed router launches do not.
T1/T8 dispatch loses the parent UV/fused pooler-router path, adding separate router and boundary1; T32 o moves to cuBLAS.
Matched qkv durations increase in all eight small-T captures; this is stronger mechanism evidence than comparing differently dispatched pooler rows.
Large-T captures contain no SK2, yet speedup ratios also fall; nodes, fresh seeds, route counts, baseline times and tuning differ.
No device evidence isolates sparse global sectors, correction-tail waits, table scans or register pressure as the cause.
Local candidate log is empty and result log_tail contains profiler messages; no compiler/register/spill/pmax measurements are available.

source_scan_analysis.E: exact escape count for one CTA
source_scan_analysis.N: NESC, active changed profiles use3 or4
source_scan_analysis.parent: N*E successful pointer increments, not E: every warp scans each entry; owner reads int2, nonowners inspect x. Stage boundaries add lookahead reads.
source_scan_analysis.candidate: N*E int2 source accesses, plus per-entry stage/range/modulo tests. Compiler may sink the delta load into owned branch.
source_scan_analysis.not_measured_traffic: Warp-uniform shared reads broadcast; multiply neither formula by32. Instructions, bank transactions and global reads require device evidence.
source_scan_analysis.partition_feasibility: Stable plane grouping preserves original per-plane order, but requires KST/NESC-specific metadata. Pooler same table uses NESC4 atTOKR8/16 andNESC3 at32.
source_scan_analysis.alternative_directory: Immutable per-stage start/end offsets preserve original table and support variableNESC:4*(K/KST+1)B perCTA,20–132B across active geometries. Each warp visits only its assigned stage intervals; no implementation authorized.
